name: ntr_wh_gap
xsql:
SELECT 
    name AS COS_Name,
    
    CASE 
        WHEN CAST(rank_primary AS FLOAT) < CAST(rank_secondary AS FLOAT) 
             THEN CAST(rank_secondary AS FLOAT) - CAST(rank_primary AS FLOAT)
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS Volume_Retention,
    

    CASE 
        WHEN CAST(rank_secondary AS FLOAT) < CAST(rank_primary AS FLOAT) 
             THEN CAST(rank_primary AS FLOAT) - CAST(rank_secondary AS FLOAT)
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS Points_Goal,
    
    -- Sorter column capturing absolute rank variance
    rank_gap AS Total_Gap

FROM (
    SELECT 
        name,
        rank_primary,
        rank_secondary,
        CASE 
            WHEN rank_primary > rank_secondary THEN rank_primary - rank_secondary
            ELSE rank_secondary - rank_primary
        END AS rank_gap
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            name, 
            RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sub1_payout DESC) AS rank_primary,
            RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sub2_payout DESC) AS rank_secondary
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                SubString(part.name, 0, IndexOf(part.name, '(')) AS name, 
                
                -- Capture Initial Patients Payout
                SUM(CASE WHEN Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Volume Retention' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS sub1_payout,
                
                -- Capture Follow On Patients Payout
                SUM(CASE WHEN Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Points Goal' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS sub2_payout
                
            FROM xactly.xc_payment p
            INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant part
                ON p.participant_id = part.participant_id
            
            -- 1. Embedded Position Region Mapping (For Parameter Filter)
            INNER JOIN $framework.ntr_db_get_position_region_mapping pos_reg 
                ON p.position_id = pos_reg.master_position_id

            -- 2. Embedded Title Mapping
            INNER JOIN (
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    ppa.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
                    pta.title_name AS title_name
                FROM xactly.xc_period per 
                INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa 
                    ON ppa.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
                INNER JOIN xactly.xc_position pos 
                    ON ppa.position_id = pos.position_id
                    AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pos.effective_start_date AS DATE)
                    AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pos.effective_end_date AS DATE)
                INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_title_assignment pta 
                    ON pos.position_id = pta.position_id
                WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
            ) pta ON p.participant_id = pta.master_participant_id
            
            -- 3. Embedded Territory Mapping
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    pa_input.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
                    pa_active.territory AS territory
                FROM xactly.xc_period per 
                INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_input 
                    ON pa_input.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
                INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_active 
                    ON pa_input.employee_id = pa_active.employee_id
                    AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pa_active.effective_start_date AS DATE)
                    AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pa_active.effective_end_date AS DATE)
                WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
            ) ter ON p.participant_id = ter.master_participant_id

            INNER JOIN NATERA_MASTER_MAPPING m 
                ON p.earning_group_name = m.earning_group
               AND pta.title_name = m.title
               
            LEFT JOIN NATERA_TERRITORY_MAPPING tm 
                ON ter.territory = tm.territory 
            
            WHERE p.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
              AND p.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
              AND m.category = 'WH'
              AND (:p_region = 'ALL' OR pos_reg.region IN (:p_region))
            GROUP BY 
                SubString(part.name, 0, IndexOf(part.name, '('))
        ) BaseData
    ) RankedSubcategories
) FinalData
ORDER BY Total_Gap DESC
LIMIT 10;
